Copper alloy coin: Radiate indeterminate, issue of 260-275, Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [---]AVG. Reverse description: Salus standing facing holding head to right holding snake in left arm, right hand holding patera. Reverse inscription: S[ALVS AVG]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin.
